goal: Help users and GUIs track which master key belongs to which cosigner or hardware device in multisig setups
Allow assigning and retrieving friendly labels for master key fingerprints across wallet RPCs
agreement: Open blocking objections against persisting labels in the wallet database and exposing them via RPC
Unaddressed objection: labels in DB are unnecessary if only needed during multisig GUI setup (achow101)
Blocking objection: ongoing maintenance costs for RPCs offer little benefit (rkrux)
Support for persisting key labels to help identify cosigners during signing (davidgumberg, vicjuma)
Concept approval after testing and resolving earlier comments (jeanpablojp, Eunovo)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because key labels offer a UX convenience for multisig setups by mapping fingerprints to cosigner names
Helpful for multi-signing workflows but remains a deferrable feature enhancement
